title: Game Of Life Step
prompt: Given a grid as an array of rows, where every row has the same length and every cell is 1 for alive or 0 for dead, return the grid after one step of Conway's Game of Life. Each cell has up to eight neighbors, including diagonals, and cells outside the grid count as dead. A live cell with two or three live neighbors stays alive and any other live cell dies. A dead cell with exactly three live neighbors becomes alive. All cells change at the same time, based only on the grid before the step. An empty grid stays empty.
